$comment: Checkout, account and the configurator: LCP <= 2.5s, initial JS <= 200 KB. Signed out, which is the heavier render for sign-in and the empty state for the rest. RATCHET: the target in docs/performance-budgets.md is 200 KB of initial JS; the shell alone measures ~254 KB, account/sign-in 254–268 KB and the configurator 283–284 KB (F3 3.2–3.3 — its stepper, live price and dock, with every step after the first loaded on demand), so the assertion is pinned just above the heaviest page. It stops the number growing while the gap is worked down — it is not the budget. Lower the ceiling whenever a change wins headroom; never raise it without saying why in docs/PROGRESS.md. U3.1 (2026-10-02) raised 293000 -> 327000: main already measured 319069 on /configure/tuck-end-box and 308493 on /account/designs (pre-existing, from the U-F0 migrations, not yet explained - follow-up in PROGRESS U3.1); U3.1's recipe engine adds ~7.4 KB (326473 / 315900). U2.F1 (2026-10-04) raised 327000 -> 337000: /configure/tuck-end-box measures 336117 — the configurator v2 size step (measurement basis, the API conversion and per-pattern bases, derived sizes, diagrams) and the per-calculator configurations are on the first paint; the advisor, target price, summary and draft UIs load on demand. U4.6 (2026-10-05) raised 339000 -> 340000: 339234 — the studio's order and lock copy rides in every customer page's messages (docs/performance-budgets.md U4.6). U3.4 wave 2 (2026-10-06) raised 340000 -> 340200: 340092 — the core engine's share of the wave-2 modules (an n-sided polygon lid, marks on tube panels, under/offset placement, the lid window lookup) that the configurator draws with; the new recipes and modules themselves stay in @getpack/dieline/library. U5.1–U5.7 (2026-10-06) raised 340200 -> 346000: 345833 against main's 340082 measured on a private port — 2,960 B on every customer page (the U5 copy in the client messages, 12 new routes in the router's table, the next-step link in the error boundary) and 2,790 B of the configurator's own: the first-visit intent picker (loaded only for a browser that has not seen it, which Lighthouse never has), the price-change reason, the guest's unit and the glossary chips (their popover loads on first press) (docs/performance-budgets.md U5.1).
